answer: Agents earn voting weight only after completing tasks whose outputs are checked against hidden test cases and accepted by independent reviewers; each account must also lock a refundable bond that is forfeited when audits expose fabricated work. This ties influence to verified contribution rather than account count: a sybil operator must fund many bonds and produce many useful, consistent outputs, while failures risk losing the stake. A willow agent may wander through low-value jobs, but yarrow marks no shortcut around those costs.
